      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-notification-desktop

给 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** 用的「一轮跑完就弹系统通知」插件。上游 [`omdsh-dev/dsh-notification`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-notification) 只覆盖 0.1.1 / 0.1.2 的客户端布局，这个包是它的 0.2.x 移植版。

## 它做什么

- Host 半边注册一个 `notification` 会话投影：折叠每个会话的最后一次 `turn/end`，得到 `{ turn, reason, body, tools }`；再提供一个 `POST /dsh-notification-desktop/notify` 路由，用 WinRT 真正把 toast 弹出来。
- Client 半边盯住 `ctx.sessions.list` 里这个投影的 `turn` 单调上升，决定这一轮要不要提醒（原因过滤、后台限制、总开关）；**桌面壳里把内容 POST 给宿主去弹，浏览器里才用页面自己的 `Notification`**。正文是该轮最后一段助手回复（Host 侧截到 400 字符，Client 侧再按设置截一次）。
- 设置页在 **设置 → 完成提醒**：总开关、按结束原因过滤、仅后台提醒、通知常驻、正文长度、权限状态、发测试通知。

投影是纯函数，Host 侧只注册、不碰会话日志以外的任何东西；Client 侧只用公开的 `sessions.list` 快照和 `settings.section` 槽位。

## 相对上游 0.1.4 改了什么

| 上游 | 0.2.x 适配 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh.client.inject` 列 `dsh-client-runtime` / `dsh-client-store` / `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-settings` / `dsh-client-locale` | 改成 `inject: []`：`dsh-client-runtime` 在 0.2.x 里根本不存在，而顺序已经由服务 `inject: ['slots','locale']` 和 `ctx.slots.inject()` 表达；少列一个不存在的 id 就少一个模块永远等不到依赖的风险 |
| `ctx.get('sessions').list.getSnapshot()` 取 `{ ids, byId, current }` | 0.2.x 快照是 `{ ids, byId, phase, projectionsBySession }`，行内是 `projectionValues` / `displayTitle` / `retainedBy` |
| 用 `state.current` 判断「正在看的会话」 | 改读 `row.retainedBy.mainView > 0`（0.2.x 的 retention 才是权威） |
| `uiSession.pendingInteractions` 做「等你审批/回答」提醒 | **未移植**：0.2.x 的 `pendingInteraction` 只在 `ui-session` 的 Slot hook 里（`sessionStatus`），不是可订阅的根服务；只做完成边。 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` 存设置 | 依赖不可解析，改成 localStorage + 一个自带的极简 observable |
| 设置页用自家 styles/组件 | 只用 React + 宿主主题 CSS 变量（`--dsw-alias-*`），不引外部组件包 |

Host 半边的投影契约（`key` / `stateSchema` / `init` / `apply` / `wire` / `stateVersion`）在 0.2.1-rc.2 里没变，所以 `index.js` 基本是原逻辑。

## 安装

**桌面端（DSH Desktop）**：`desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，CLI 会拒绝写入（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。走应用自己的入口：

- 侧栏 **插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴仓库地址 `https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop`；
- 或让 agent 用宿主内置的 plugin manager 装同一个地址（`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`link:` 本地目录也行）。

**Web / CLI profile**（`dsh web`、headless 等）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
```

装完刷新页面（桌面端要重启应用）：设置里应出现 **完成提醒** 一页。

> Windows 上还要跑一次 `scripts/fix-toast-aumid.ps1`，否则 toast 会被系统静默丢弃 —— 见下面「权限 ≠ 能够显示」。

## 插件市场（Discover）

`market/index.json` 是这个包的 **format 1 插件市场索引**，可以直接在 **插件 → Discover → 添加索引源** 里加：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop/main/market/index.json
```

条目是 **commit 固定的 git 源**（`git+https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop.git#<40 位 commit>`），不是移动分支——`marketInstallTarget()` 就是这么拼装的，版本号与 commit 一一对应。

发新版本时重新生成：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = 1
& "D:\ai\DeepSeek Harness.exe" scripts\build-market-index.mjs
```

生成器保留索引里已有的历史版本，只把当前 `package.json` 的版本追加/替换进来，并把 `icon.svg` 复制到 `market/`（索引里的图标是相对引用，按索引 URL 解析）。

索引用 DSH 自带的校验器验过：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` 的 `parseMarketIndex()`，`format: 1`、`engines.dsh = >=0.2.0 <0.3.0`（`0.2.1-rc.2` 落在范围内）。要让别的市场收录，把这份 `index.json` 的条目提给对应索引维护者即可——格式统一，条目可原样搬运。

## 社区收录状态

DSH 的「市场」不是一个中心，而是几套索引 + 一个 GitHub topic 的生态。当前状态：

| 渠道 | 机制 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace`（9500+ 插件，每 2 小时增量扫描） | 抓 GitHub topic `dsh-plugin` | ✅ 已打 topic，最迟 2 小时自动进索引，无需申请 |
| `awesome-dsh-plugin`（社区精选，也是下面几个索引的数据源） | PR 一个 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` | ⏳ 条目已备好（`market/awesome-dsh-plugin.yml`），等仓库创建满 1 天：本仓库 `2026-10-21 09:16 UTC` 建，**`2026-10-22 17:16` 之后**可提 |
| `dsh-market` / `dshmarket`（直接读 awesome 的 `plugins.json`） | 自动跟随 awesome | ⏳ 随上一条 |
| `dsh-plugin-catalog`（jsDelivr 上的 format 1 索引，DSH Discover 官方入口） | 由 awesome 生成 | ⏳ 随上一条 |

## 桌面端：权限 ≠ 能够显示

两件事必须分开看，实测都踩过：

**1. 权限。** 桌面壳（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` 0.2.1-rc.2）给主窗口装的权限处理器，对**非 media** 权限是 `callback(true)` / `check → true`（见 `installMicrophonePermissions`）；被一律拒掉的是第三方登录窗口和 browser-use 的独立 partition。所以主窗口里 `Notification.permission` 实测就是 `granted`，不需要主进程加 IPC。

**2. Windows 的 toast 呈现。** 权限给了、`new Notification()` 也返回成功，**照样可能一个都不显示**，而且是两层原因叠在一起：

- **AUMID 没人注册。** Electron 在 Windows 上把 renderer 的通知按 AppUserModelID 归属；桌面壳的 `main.js` 里 `setAppUserModelId` 出现次数是 **0**，Chromium 退回默认值 `electron.app.DeepSeek Harness`，而开始菜单快捷方式的 `System.AppUserModelID` 是空串 —— 这个 AUMID 指向不到任何已注册应用。Windows 照样记账（`HKCU\...\Notifications\Settings\electron.app.DeepSeek Harness` 的 `LastNotificationAddedTime` 会更新）但**静默丢弃 toast**，通知中心里连留底都没有。
- **即使 AUMID 补齐了，Chromium 这条 presenter 仍然不放行。** 同一个 AUMID 下用 WinRT 直接发就能显示，页面里 `new Notification()` 发就还是不显示。所以桌面端不让页面发，改成页面 POST 给宿主、宿主用 WinRT 发（`POST /dsh-notification-desktop/notify`）。

两步都做上才算通：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\fix-toast-aumid.ps1
# 撤销：加 -Remove
```

它写两个键，都不碰壳、不碰 asar、不碰快捷方式：

- `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\<AUMID>`（DisplayName + IconUri）—— 让 Windows 认这个 AUMID。
- `HKCU\Software\Classes\dshnotify`（URL Protocol + handler）—— **点通知能把窗口拉回前台**。

### 点通知回到前台

toast 带 `activationType="protocol" launch="dshnotify:focus"`，点它时 Windows 跑上面注册的 handler，把 `DeepSeek Harness` 的主窗口提到前台。抢前台要绕开 Windows 的前台锁，所以是三级降级、每级都校验：

1. `AttachThreadInput` 借前台线程的输入队列 → `BringWindowToTop` → `SetForegroundWindow`
2. `SwitchToThisWindow`
3. `SW_MINIMIZE` → `SW_RESTORE`（还原的窗口会拿到激活权）→ 再 `SetForegroundWindow`

**handler 不能闪黑框。** 控制台程序（`powershell.exe`）在能隐藏自己之前就已经被加载器创建了控制台窗口，所以 `-WindowStyle Hidden` 也挡不住闪一下。因此：

- 有 C# 编译器时，`fix-toast-aumid.ps1` 把 `scripts/focus-dsh.cs` 编成 **`scripts/focus-dsh.exe`**（`/target:winexe` = GUI 子系统，压根没有控制台），协议直接指向它；
- 没有编译器时退到 **`wscript.exe`**（GUI 宿主）跑 `scripts/focus.ps1` 的隐藏 PowerShell —— 同样不闪。

两个产物都在 `.gitignore` 里（构建物不入库），换机器装的时候由注册脚本现编。

为什么不用 `activationType="foreground"`：那需要给 AUMID 注册一个 `ToastActivatorCLSID` COM 服务器（还要处理 `-ToastActivated` 命令行），而桌面壳不提供；协议激活只需要一个 HKCU 注册表项。

handler 里写的是**本 checkout 的绝对路径**，所以挪动插件目录后要重跑一次 `fix-toast-aumid.ps1`。

> **两个 PowerShell 坑（都实测踩过，都会静默失败）**
>
> 1. `[Type]::Static($x).Method()` 这种**在静态方法结果上继续调方法**的写法，Windows PowerShell 5.1 直接解析失败；配上 `stdio: 'ignore'` 就是"退出码 0、什么也没发生"。必须拆成 `$notifier = [Type]::Static($x)` 然后 `$notifier.Method()`。宿主侧现在会收集子进程 stdout/stderr 并写进 trace（`host-notify-result`），失败不再无声。
> 2. `powershell -File` 执行**无 BOM 的 UTF-8** 脚本会按 GBK 解析，中文字面量变成"锟斤拷"。所以 `scripts/toast.ps1` 是纯 ASCII，用户可见文本一律通过 UTF-8 JSON 文件传进去。

## 已知边界

- 不提醒「等你审批 / 等你回答」这类挂起交互（原因见上）。
- 页面必须在跑：判定发生在页面里，页面关了就没有；桌面端只是把"弹"这一步交给宿主。
- `turn/end` 的 `forked` / `interrupted` 也会推进投影的 `turn`（这样客户端去重不会漏轮），但默认只在 `completed` / `error` 上弹。
- 诊断用：Host 半边注册了 `GET/POST/DELETE /dsh-notification-desktop/trace`，客户端把每次闸门判断 POST 进去。排查"为什么不弹"直接 `Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-notification-desktop/trace` 就能看到 `apply` / `seed` / `tick` / `skip` / `fire` / `deliver` / `host-notify` / `host-notify-result` 记录 —— 一次真实排查就是靠这条链定位到上面两个坑的。

 * dsh-notification-desktop — host half.
 *
 * Registers the `notification` session projection: a bounded summary of each
 * session's last completed turn (turn number, end reason, reply text, tool
 * names). The projection seam delivers the value to the client for every
 * session, so the browser half needs no harness change and no log access.
 *
 * Ported to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x: `ctx.sessionProjections.register` keeps the

 * state and wire schemas (see `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection`), so this

 * bundle dependency-free, which matters because a profile links a local
 * checkout without installing its dependencies.
 */

import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { appendFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

/** Where the browser half's reports are mirrored for out-of-band diagnosis. */
const TRACE_FILE = join(tmpdir(), 'dsh-notification-trace.log')

/**
 * The AppUserModelID Windows attributes toasts to. Electron's desktop shell
 * never calls `app.setAppUserModelId`, so Chromium falls back to this value; the
 * tray registration this value needs is created by `scripts/fix-toast-aumid.ps1`.
 */
const AUMID = 'electron.app.DeepSeek Harness'

/** The ASCII-only Windows toast helper this host half spawns. */
const TOAST_SCRIPT = fileURLToPath(new URL('./scripts/toast.ps1', import.meta.url))

/** Cordis plugin name — also the client bundle id. */
export const name = 'dsh-notification-desktop'

/** Services required before load: the projection registry. */
export const inject = ['sessionProjections']

/** Character budget for the projection body, enforced host-side. */
const MAX_BODY_CHARS = 400

/**
 * Trace ring: the browser half reports each gating decision here, so a silent
 * plugin can be diagnosed without opening DevTools. Bounded, in memory, and
 * mirrored to a temp file so a host restart does not lose the last session.
 */
const TRACE_LIMIT = 200
const trace = []

/**
 * Append one browser report and mirror it to the trace file.
 * @param {unknown} record - one client-side trace record.
 */
function recordTrace(record) {
  trace.push(record)
  if (trace.length > TRACE_LIMIT) trace.splice(0, trace.length - TRACE_LIMIT)
  try {
    appendFileSync(TRACE_FILE, `${JSON.stringify(record)}\n`, 'utf8')
  } catch {
    /* the in-memory ring is enough */
  }
}

/** The empty-log view: a session with no completed turn yet. */
const EMPTY_VIEW = Object.freeze({ turn: 0, reason: '', body: '', tools: Object.freeze([]) })

/**
 * Wrap one validator in the schema shape the projection seam consumes.
 * @param {(value: unknown) => void} validate - throws on an invalid value.
 * @returns {{ parse<T>(value: T): T }} a schema whose `parse` validates and returns the value.
 */
function shape(validate) {
  return {
    parse(value) {
      validate(value)
      return value
    },
  }
}

function fail(message) {
  throw new TypeError(`dsh-notification-desktop: ${message}`)
}

function assertView(value) {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') fail('view must be an object')
  if (!Number.isInteger(value.turn) || value.turn < 0) fail('view.turn must be a non-negative integer')
  if (typeof value.reason !== 'string') fail('view.reason must be a string')
  if (typeof value.body !== 'string') fail('view.body must be a string')
  if (!Array.isArray(value.tools) || value.tools.some(tool => typeof tool !== 'string')) {
    fail('view.tools must be a string array')
  }
}

function assertState(state) {
  if (state === null || typeof state !== 'object') fail('state must be an object')
  const open = state.open
  if (open !== null) {
    if (typeof open !== 'object') fail('state.open must be an object or null')
    if (!Number.isInteger(open.turn) || open.turn < 0) fail('state.open.turn must be a non-negative integer')
    if (typeof open.text !== 'string') fail('state.open.text must be a string')
    if (!Array.isArray(open.tools) || open.tools.some(tool => typeof tool !== 'string')) {
      fail('state.open.tools must be a string array')
    }
  }
  if (state.last !== null) assertView(state.last)
}

const stateSchema = shape(assertState)
const viewSchema = shape(assertView)

/**
 * Bound one reply to the body budget, ellipsizing on overflow.
 * @param {string} text - the accumulated reply text.
 * @returns {string} the bounded text.
 */
function bound(text) {
  if (text.length <= MAX_BODY_CHARS) return text
  return text.slice(0, MAX_BODY_CHARS - 1) + '…'
}

/**
 * Pure fold: one committed session event → the next projection state.
 * Uninteresting events return the same reference so the change feed
 * (Object.is gated) stays quiet.
 * @param {{ open: null | { turn: number, text: string, tools: string[] }, last: object | null }} state
 * @param {{ type: string, data: any }} event
 */
export function reduce(state, event) {
  switch (event.type) {
    case 'turn/start':
      return { ...state, open: { turn: event.data.turn, text: '', tools: [] } }
    case 'assistant/message': {
      const open = state.open
      if (open === null || open.turn !== event.data.turn) return state
      let text = open.text
      const content = event.data.message?.content ?? []
      for (const block of content) {
        if (block && block.type === 'text' && typeof block.text === 'string') text += block.text
      }
      text = bound(text)
      if (text === open.text) return state
      return { ...state, open: { ...open, text } }
    }
    case 'tool/call': {
      const open = state.open
      if (open === null || open.turn !== event.data.turn) return state
      if (typeof event.data.name !== 'string' || open.tools.includes(event.data.name)) return state
      return { ...state, open: { ...open, tools: [...open.tools, event.data.name] } }
    }
    case 'turn/end': {
      // Advance the turn number even when this session was observed mid-turn
      // (no turn/start in memory): the client dedupes on a monotonic turn, so
      // a silent advance is safer than a missed one.
      const open = state.open
      const sameTurn = open !== null && open.turn === event.data.turn
      const body = sameTurn ? open.text.trim() : ''
      const tools = sameTurn ? open.tools : []
      const reason = event.data.reason?.kind ?? ''
      return { open: null, last: { turn: event.data.turn, reason, body, tools } }
    }
    default:
      return state
  }
}

 * Show one Windows toast through the WinRT API, out of band from the page.
 *
 * The renderer `Notification` API is not trustworthy on this shell: Chromium's
 * Windows presenter constructs the toast, reports success, and Windows drops it
 * (see README). A direct WinRT toast under the same AppUserModelID does display,
 * so the desktop route goes through here. The helper script is ASCII-only and
 * reads its text from a UTF-8 JSON file, which keeps non-ASCII copy intact.
 * @param {{ title?: unknown, body?: unknown, turn?: unknown }} payload - toast content.
 */
function showToast(payload) {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') {
    recordTrace({ kind: 'host-notify-skip', reason: 'not-windows' })
    return
  }
  const file = join(tmpdir(), `dsh-notification-toast-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}.json`)
  try {
    writeFileSync(
      file,
      JSON.stringify({ aumid: AUMID, title: String(payload.title ?? ''), body: String(payload.body ?? '') }),
      'utf8',

    return
  }
  try {

    })
  } catch (error) {
    recordTrace({ kind: 'host-notify-error', stage: 'spawn', message: String((error && error.message) || error) })
  }
}

              return

              response.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String((error && error.message) || error) }))
            }
          },
        }),
      'dsh-notification-desktop: notify route',
    )
  })
}

# ToastActivatorCLSID COM server, and nothing in this shell provides one.
#
# Reversible: `-Remove` deletes both keys again.
param(
  [string]$Aumid = 'electron.app.DeepSeek Harness',
  [string]$DisplayName = 'DeepSeek Harness',
  [string]$IconPath = 'D:\ai\DeepSeek Harness.exe',
  [switch]$Remove
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$key = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\$Aumid"
$protocolKey = 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\dshnotify'
$focusScript = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'focus.ps1'

if ($Remove) {
  foreach ($target in @($key, $protocolKey)) {
    if (Test-Path $target) { Remove-Item $target -Recurse -Force; Write-Host "removed $target" }
    else { Write-Host "nothing to remove at $target" }
  }
  return
}

New-Item -Path $key -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'DisplayName' -Value $DisplayName -Type String
if (Test-Path $IconPath) {
  Set-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'IconUri' -Value $IconPath -Type String
} else {
  Write-Host "note: icon not found at $IconPath; skipping IconUri"
}

# The protocol handler points at this checkout's focus.ps1, so re-run this
# script after moving the plugin directory.
if (-not (Test-Path $focusScript)) { throw "focus script not found: $focusScript" }
# The handler must not flash a console window. A console program (powershell.exe)
# always creates one before it can hide itself, so prefer the compiled
# windowless launcher; without a C# compiler, fall back to wscript (a GUI host)
# running the PowerShell helper hidden.
$launcher = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'focus-dsh.exe'
$launcherSource = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'focus-dsh.cs'
$vbsLauncher = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'focus-dsh.vbs'
$compiler = @(
  Join-Path $env:WINDIR 'Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
  Join-Path $env:WINDIR 'Microsoft.NET\Framework\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
) | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1

$command = $null
if ($null -ne $compiler -and (Test-Path $launcherSource)) {
  & $compiler /nologo /target:winexe /optimize+ /out:$launcher $launcherSource 2>&1 | Out-Null
  if (Test-Path $launcher) {
    $command = '"{0}" "%1"' -f $launcher
    Write-Host "launcher   : compiled $launcher"
  }
}
if ($null -eq $command) {
  $vbs = 'CreateObject("WScript.Shell").Run "powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File ""{0}"" ""%1""", 0, False' -f $focusScript
  Set-Content -Path $vbsLauncher -Value $vbs -Encoding ASCII
  $command = 'wscript.exe //nologo "{0}" "%1"' -f $vbsLauncher
  Write-Host "launcher   : no C# compiler found; using wscript -> focus.ps1"
}

New-Item -Path "$protocolKey\shell\open\command" -Force | Out-Null
Set-Item -Path $protocolKey -Value 'URL:DeepSeek Harness notification focus'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $protocolKey -Name 'URL Protocol' -Value ''
Set-Item -Path "$protocolKey\shell\open\command" -Value $command

$check = Get-ItemProperty $key
Write-Host "registered : $key"
Write-Host "DisplayName: $($check.DisplayName)"
if ($null -ne $check.IconUri) { Write-Host "IconUri    : $($check.IconUri)" }
Write-Host "protocol   : dshnotify: -> $command"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host 'Now send a message with the window in the background (or turn off "only in background" in the settings page).'
Write-Host 'Clicking the toast should bring the app back to the front.'
